title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.81
summary: Gezielter Encoder-Fallback für belegte H.264-Parameter- und HLS-Zeitstempelfehler sowie korrekte FFmpeg-Exitprotokolle.
changes: Allow codec-evidenced copy-to-encoder fallback for PPS/SPS initialization faults
Allow timestamp-evidenced fallback on HLS packets with zero duration
Avoid encoder retries on EOF or no-frame stalls
Preserve FFMPEG_EXIT event code alongside separate numeric exitCode
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.81
description: Evidence-based copy-video fallback for broken PPS and packet durations; preserve accurate FFmpeg exit events.
releaseNotes: 2.20.81 retries the next existing encoder only for evidenced H264 parameter-set or packet timestamp faults in the copy path. EOF and empty video streams do not cause extra encoder attempts. FFMPEG_EXIT is preserved as an event code and exitCode is logged separately. All camera and recording settings remain unchanged.
